title: Deterrence Symposium
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE.AIR COMBAT COMMAND.FA4600  55 CONS  PKP
detail_text: This is a non-personal services contract for the provision of comprehensive Event Planning, Attendee Registration, Venue Support, and Audio-Visual Services in support of the United States Strategic Command (USSTRATCOM) Deterrence Symposium and related activities. 55 CONS intends to solicit this contract through Oral Solicitation using Simplified Acquisition Procedures IAW FAR Overhaul 12. All responsible sources may request to be included in the future Oral Solicitation by submitting an email with capabilities statement to the contracting office before 12:00 PM CDT on April 10, 2026.
